name: Prunr
blurb: Prunr is a fast and powerful tool for disk cleanup.
description:
Prunr is a fast and powerful tool for disk cleanup. Use it to analyze disk
usage, identify duplicate files, and safely reclaim wasted space.

Features:

• Duplicate detection: Fast (hardware-accelerated) duplicate file scanning. Supports previews, filters and auto-selection options to safely and easily cleanup files.

• Analyze disk usage: Interactive treemap and sunburst visualizations show where disk space is going, color-coded by file type.

• Secure and open source: Prunr runs fully locally and no data ever leaves your system.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
